params.message:
Agenda: every step and every item shown at once

The agenda held back the projects and people until ten relations were
discussed, and showed ten items per step at a time. The table decides
what to talk about; the order stays (network, projects, people) but
nothing is locked any more.

Agenda::BATCH, the per-step open flag and the shown slice go; a step is
its items with how many are done.
